features: Ultra-Slim Metal Design: Crafted with a premium metal body and a sleek 8 mm profile, this watch sits comfortably on your wrist while still standing out as a stylish statement piece wherever you go. Complementing the design, the leather strap variant adds a classic analog feel, making it the perfect companion for both boardroom meetings and weekend getaways/li>

3.63 cm (1.43 inch) AMOLED Display: At the center of the Aeris experience is the stunning 3.63 cm (1.43 inch) AMOLED display. With a peak brightness of 1000 nits and resolution of 466 × 466, your stats remain vivid and easy to read even under the harsh midday sun. The Always-On Display (AOD) always keeps your favourite watch face visible, combining the elegance of a traditional timepiece with modern functionality/li>

Auto HR & SpO2 Monitoring: Built with advanced health sensors, Aeris automatically tracks your heart rate and SpO2 24/7. Whether you're training hard or focusing on healthy ageing, it helps you stay aware of your health and overall fitness so you can perform better today while taking care of your long-term well-being/li>

Sleep & Stress Tracking: Ultima Aeris tracks your sleep in detail, including Sleep Duration, Deep Sleep, Light Sleep, REM Sleep, and Awake time, helping you understand the quality of your rest, not just the hours slept. It also monitors your maximum and minimum stress levels throughout the day, helping you identify patterns and build healthier habits. Use Guided Breathing Mode anytime to practise techniques like box breathing and stay calm and balanced/li>

Activity Tracking: Along with monitoring your rest and recovery, Ultima Aeris also keeps track of your daily activity. From your morning walk to taking the stairs or heading out for a run, Ultima Aeris tracks your steps, calories burnt, and distance covered to help you stay mindful of your daily activity/li>

Female Wellness Tracking: Beyond everyday activity tracking, Ultima Aeris also supports female wellness tracking to help you stay in sync with your body’s natural rhythms. With discreet alerts for menstrual and ovulation cycles delivered directly to your watch, you can manage your busy schedule with confidence and peace of mind/li>

Multiple Sports Modes: Whether you're hitting the gym or finding your Zen, Aeris is built to help you go the extra mile. With a wide range of sports modes, including Outdoor and Indoor Running, Cycling, Yoga, and team sports like Football and Basketball, this watch ensures your efforts are always tracked. By monitoring duration, distance, and calories tailored to your activity, it gives you a clear picture of your progress so you can stay on top of your game/li>

Advanced Bluetooth Calling: Stay connected on the move with Ultima Aeris and make or receive calls directly from your watch, whether you're driving, on a run, or busy with your day. Check recent, missed, and outgoing calls anytime, and add up to 20 frequently dialed contacts so you can reach the people you talk to most faster and without reaching for your phone/li>

Functional Crown: For quick control, Ultima Aeris features a Functional Crown along with touch navigation. So, when you're commuting, at the gym, carrying things, or simply in a hurry, you can easily scroll through the main menu and make selections with a simple twist/li>

Smart Utilities: Make everyday tasks easier with Ultima Aeris, right from your wrist. Control music and camera, check the weather, use the voice assistant, view the world clock, receive notifications, and access SOS whenever needed, so your essentials stay just a tap away/li>
